WITH events AS (
    SELECT 'race' AS kind, race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sprint', race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.sprint_results
),
event_keys AS (
    SELECT kind, race_id, driver_id, COUNT(*) AS entries
    FROM events GROUP BY kind, race_id, driver_id
),
event_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, e.driver_id, SUM(e.points) AS points,
           SUM(CASE WHEN e.kind = 'race' THEN e.points ELSE 0 END) AS race_only_points,
           COUNT(DISTINCT e.constructor_id) AS entered_teams
    FROM events AS e
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = e.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, e.driver_id
),
minimums AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(CASE WHEN points > 0 THEN points END) AS event_minimum,
           MIN(CASE WHEN race_only_points > 0 THEN race_only_points END) AS race_minimum
    FROM event_totals GROUP BY year
),
standing_rounds AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(r.round) AS last_standing_round
    FROM main.driver_standings AS s
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = s.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 GROUP BY r.year
),
season_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS max_race_round FROM main.races WHERE year >= 2001 GROUP BY year
),
last_standings AS (
    SELECT r.year, s.driver_id, s.points
    FROM main.driver_standings AS s
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = s.race_id
    JOIN standing_rounds AS sr ON sr.year = r.year AND sr.last_standing_round = r.round
),
standing_minimums AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(points) AS standing_minimum
    FROM last_standings WHERE points > 0 GROUP BY year
),
standing_differences AS (
    SELECT et.year,
           SUM(et.points <> COALESCE(ls.points, 0)) AS driver_total_differences,
           SUM((et.points = m.event_minimum) <> COALESCE(ls.points = sm.standing_minimum, 0)) AS min_driver_differences,
           SUM((et.points = m.event_minimum) <> (et.race_only_points = m.race_minimum)) AS min_driver_race_only_differences
    FROM event_totals AS et
    JOIN minimums AS m ON m.year = et.year
    LEFT JOIN last_standings AS ls ON ls.year = et.year AND ls.driver_id = et.driver_id
    LEFT JOIN standing_minimums AS sm ON sm.year = et.year
    GROUP BY et.year
)
SELECT m.year, ss.max_race_round, sr.last_standing_round,
       m.event_minimum, sm.standing_minimum, m.race_minimum,
       sd.driver_total_differences, sd.min_driver_differences, sd.min_driver_race_only_differences,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_keys WHERE entries > 1) AS duplicate_event_driver_keys,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE points < 0 OR points IS NULL) AS negative_or_null_points,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events AS e LEFT JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = e.race_id
          LEFT JOIN main.constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = e.constructor_id
          WHERE r.race_id IS NULL OR c.constructor_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_event_rows
FROM minimums AS m
JOIN season_rounds AS ss ON ss.year = m.year
LEFT JOIN standing_rounds AS sr ON sr.year = m.year
LEFT JOIN standing_minimums AS sm ON sm.year = m.year
JOIN standing_differences AS sd ON sd.year = m.year
ORDER BY m.year

arguments.sql:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT 'race' AS kind, race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sprint', race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.sprint_results
),
in_scope AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, e.* FROM events AS e
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = e.race_id WHERE r.year >= 2001
),
event_keys AS (
    SELECT kind, race_id, driver_id, COUNT(*) AS entries
    FROM in_scope GROUP BY kind, race_id, driver_id
),
driver_team_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, SUM(points) AS team_points
    FROM in_scope GROUP BY year, driver_id, constructor_id
),
driver_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(team_points) AS season_points,
           MIN(SUM(team_points)) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS minimum_positive_points
    FROM driver_team_totals GROUP BY year, driver_id HAVING SUM(team_points) > 0
),
minimum_driver_teams AS (
    SELECT dt.year, dt.driver_id, dtt.constructor_id, dt.season_points, dtt.team_points
    FROM driver_totals AS dt JOIN driver_team_totals AS dtt
      ON dtt.year = dt.year AND dtt.driver_id = dt.driver_id
    WHERE dt.season_points = dt.minimum_positive_points
),
team_counts AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN team_points > 0 THEN year END) AS scoring_seasons,
           COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS roster_seasons
    FROM minimum_driver_teams GROUP BY constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name, tc.scoring_seasons, tc.roster_seasons,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(m.year || '/' || m.driver_id || '/' || m.season_points)
        FROM minimum_driver_teams AS m
        WHERE m.constructor_id = tc.constructor_id AND m.team_points = 0) AS zero_point_drives,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_keys WHERE entries > 1) AS in_scope_duplicate_event_driver_keys,
       (SELECT MAX(round) FROM in_scope WHERE year = 2024) AS last_2024_result_round,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM minimum_driver_teams AS m
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.drives AS d WHERE d.year = m.year
                          AND d.driver_id = m.driver_id AND d.constructor_id = m.constructor_id)) AS missing_drive_matches,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.drives AS d JOIN driver_totals AS dt
          ON dt.year = d.year AND dt.driver_id = d.driver_id AND dt.season_points = dt.minimum_positive_points
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM minimum_driver_teams AS m WHERE m.year = d.year
                          AND m.driver_id = d.driver_id AND m.constructor_id = d.constructor_id)) AS drives_without_result_matches
FROM team_counts AS tc JOIN main.constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = tc.constructor_id
ORDER BY tc.scoring_seasons DESC, c.name, c.constructor_id

arguments.sql:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.results
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.sprint_results
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, e.driver_id, e.constructor_id, SUM(e.points) AS points
    FROM events AS e JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = e.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, e.driver_id, e.constructor_id
),
driver_points AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(points) AS season_points,
           MIN(SUM(points)) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS minimum_points
    FROM team_points GROUP BY year, driver_id HAVING SUM(points) > 0
),
lowest_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id FROM driver_points WHERE season_points = minimum_points
),
counts AS (
    SELECT tp.constructor_id, COUNT(*) AS driver_seasons, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.year) AS constructor_seasons,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.year < 2024 THEN tp.year END) AS before_2024_seasons
    FROM lowest_drivers AS ld JOIN team_points AS tp
      ON tp.year = ld.year AND tp.driver_id = ld.driver_id
    WHERE tp.points > 0 GROUP BY tp.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name, k.driver_seasons, k.constructor_seasons, k.before_2024_seasons,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
           SELECT tp.year, tp.driver_id
           FROM lowest_drivers AS ld JOIN team_points AS tp ON tp.year = ld.year AND tp.driver_id = ld.driver_id
           WHERE tp.points > 0 GROUP BY tp.year, tp.driver_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
       )) AS lowest_drivers_scoring_for_multiple_teams
FROM counts AS k JOIN main.constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = k.constructor_id
ORDER BY k.constructor_seasons DESC, c.name, c.constructor_id

),
team_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, e.driver_id, e.constructor_id, SUM(e.points) AS points
    FROM events AS e JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = e.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, e.driver_id, e.constructor_id
),
driver_points AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(points) AS season_points,

    FROM team_points GROUP BY year, driver_id HAVING SUM(points) > 0

),

    WHERE tp.points > 0 GROUP BY tp.constructor_id

           WHERE tp.points > 0 GROUP BY tp.year, tp.driver_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
       )) AS lowest_drivers_scoring_for_multiple_teams
FROM counts AS k JOIN main.constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = k.constructor_id
ORDER BY k.constructor_seasons DESC, c.name, c.constructor_id
